dimensions.rationale: The page title, range controls, KPI summary, insight, and alert sections form an unambiguous descending hierarchy, while modal titles clearly precede supporting content.
Both desktop widths preserve readable KPI grouping and insight content without overlap, and the bounded modals remain distinctly segmented.
Active navigation, date fields, grouping, resting range actions, primary actions, checkboxes, and close controls are distinguishable and consistently positioned.
The active section, applied range, selected export count, selected month, check-in total, and tied peak windows are explicitly stated rather than implied by color.
Card boundaries, gutters, section spacing, and modal grids align consistently, while the compact view preserves the same structural relationships.
Primary labels and values have strong contrast and recognizable controls, though some muted descriptions, chart labels, and metadata remain comparatively small.
Charcoal surfaces, focused orange accents, fitness iconography, and compact operational groupings produce a consistent FitTrack presentation.

findings.observation: Muted descriptions, recommendation copy, chart ticks, and some metadata remain visually small against dark surfaces.
findings.user_impact: Supporting information may require more deliberate reading than primary values.
findings.repair_direction: Raise the smallest supporting text by one typographic step when the broader typography system is next calibrated.
findings.verification: Supporting text remains comfortably readable without flattening the primary hierarchy.

findings.observation: The drilldown chart does not expose every bar value directly.
findings.user_impact: Non-peak comparisons require visual estimation or the tooltip.
findings.repair_direction: Consider concise visible values or a richer tick strategy without expanding the modal.
findings.verification: Non-peak daily values can be compared without materially increasing visual density.

dimensions.rationale: The title, range controls, headline revenue, section headings, and modal titles create a strong scan path with appropriate emphasis.
Data-rich content remains readable, compact controls reflow without crowding, and both modals stay bounded and digestible.
Tabs, date fields, checkboxes, close controls, selection count, and primary actions are recognizable, though export terminology does not perfectly mirror page taxonomy.
The active section, applied range, selected export sections, selected month, and check-in totals are exposed, while daily and hourly attendance metrics require deliberate reading.
Sidebar, content grid, gutters, cards, and modal columns align consistently with no clipping or viewport overflow.
Large values, persistent labels, checkmarks, and modal isolation support recognition, though small muted metadata remains less comfortable to read.
The orange-charcoal palette, fitness iconography, operational language, and restrained admin styling strongly match FitTrack.

findings.observation: Several export labels do not map one-to-one to visible page navigation labels.
findings.user_impact: Users may need to infer which dashboard content each PDF option includes.
findings.repair_direction: Align export labels with page taxonomy or retain concise source explanations.
findings.verification: Every export option maps immediately to recognizable dashboard content.

findings.observation: Daily totals and hourly peak-window totals use the same attendance vocabulary in the drilldown.
findings.user_impact: The two valid metrics can initially appear contradictory.
findings.repair_direction: Label daily totals and hourly peak windows even more explicitly in a future refinement.
findings.verification: The metric grain is understood without comparing surrounding labels.

findings.observation: Some helper descriptions, section eyebrows, chart labels, and recommendation copy remain subdued.
findings.user_impact: Supporting content is less comfortable to scan than headline information.
findings.repair_direction: Increase secondary contrast and minimum size during the next shared typography calibration.
findings.verification: Secondary content remains readable at both contracted desktop widths.

findings.observation: Explore Attendance sits at the section edge rather than inside the Member Activity panel.
findings.user_impact: Its relationship to the activity metrics is slightly less immediate.
findings.repair_direction: Consider placing the action inside Member Activity or labeling it as a section drilldown.
findings.verification: The action's target metrics are obvious without scanning across the section.
